A new Fighter starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23).

Defined in `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65` (mapping class → item IDs, used in `createCharacter` at `:59,65`). Item names come from the `items` table rows in `worker/src/db/seed.sql`. Note: ID 23 is actually "Torches" despite code comments calling it Rations (known bug B-09).
